content.intro: Learn installing and configuring a code editor through a compact visual, an inspectable Django example, and a practical verification task.

content_blocks.title: The core idea
content_blocks.text: This lesson examines installing and configuring a code editor as part of development environment and project setup. The objective is to understand the behavior, connect it to the listed subtopics, and verify it with a small example rather than relying on memorized syntax.
